turns.question: Which customer country brought in the most revenue per buying customer in September 2026, and how much per customer?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no revenue-per-buying-customer metric, so I can't give that figure; the closest metrics, Revenue (EUR) and Active customers by customer country for 1-30 September 2026, show DE 2,665.50 EUR from 2 customers, GB 2,634.00 EUR from 2, TR 2,412.00 EUR from 2, NL 2,408.00 EUR from 2, FR 1,241.00 EUR from 1 and US 1,222.25 EUR from 1. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
